notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand.
Elvish Piper and Vedalken Mastermind do not have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {G}{U}.
description:
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping it, adding at least {G}{U}.
Activate Elvish Piper by paying {G} and tapping it, putting any creature card from your hand onto the battlefield.
The creature enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Activate Vedalken Mastermind by paying {U} and tapping it, returning a creature card from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
